snippet.title: Veil of the Soulstones - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Brave the Veil of the Soulstones alone or with your friends in this brutal, real-time auto battler adventure. Loot weapons and armor from every foe to build your strength, and through powerful synergies, slay the creatures that lurk unseen in the shadows.

Coming to Steam in 2026, wishlist the game now!

Veil of the Soulstones on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4239080/Veil_of_the_Soulstones/

Official Discord:
https://discord.gg/gamesmithing
